note.question: How do EPR and analytically explore its environmental implications affect durable-goods producers’ secondary market strategy?
note.overview: This paper studies how extended producer responsibility (EPR) legislation implementations for durable products should differ from those for nondurable products. Certain unique characteristics of markets for durable products, which make designing EPR implementations more challenging, have not been explored to date in academia and practice. We fill this void by investigating the effect of EPR on durable-goods markets.
